name: Some Beaches Slow-Roasted Pulled Pork or Smoked Brisket Sandwich
whyItWorks: Slow-braised pulled pork and tender brisket have broken-down collagen fibers that digest smoothly on a soft bun when ordered without coleslaw.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pulled Pork or Brisket sandwich on a soft bun with BBQ sauce on the side and no raw cabbage slaw or pickled jalapeños.
watchOuts: Skip raw cabbage coleslaw and heavy smoky BBQ sauce during flares
